com.google.android.material.textview.Mat.android:text: Learn how your App gets Approved on Freetime App Store

Freetime App Store is a one Person driven App Store. I review and rebuild every app that is submitted to my Store. I do not allow Apps that are offensive or that contain hate speech. I do not allow Apps that have In-App-Purchases in it. I do not allow Apps that are sexually explicit or that contain nudity. I do not allow Apps that are discriminatory or that contain discriminatory content. The Apps should only be for Android.

When you submit an App to Freetime App Store, I will first check if the App is for Android. If the App is not for Android, I will not approve the App. If the App is for Android, I will check if the App is free of charge. If the App is not free of charge, I will not approve the App. If the App is free of charge, I will check if the App has In-App-Purchases. If the App has In-App-Purchases, I will check if the App is not a gambling App. If the App is a gambling App, I will not approve the App.

Make sure your App is Open Source and that you provide a Link to the Source Code when you submit your App to Freetime App Store. If you do not provide a Link to the Source Code, I will not approve the App. Make sure you don\'t make a Pull Request instead make a Issue. I will not approve the App if you make a Pull Request.

I review every App that is submitted to my Store. I check for the following: Is the App for Android? Is the App free of charge? Does the App has In-App-Purchases? If the App has In-App-Purchases, I check if the App is not a gambling app. If the App contains Gambling I will not approve the App. Does the App contain any offensive content? If the App contains offensive content I will not approve the App. Does the App contain any hate speech? If the App contains hate speech I will not approve the App. Does the App contain any sexually explicit content? If the App contains sexually explicit content I will not approve the App. Does the App contain any nudity? If the App contains nudity I will not approve the App. Does the App contain any discriminatory content? If the App contains discriminatory content I will not approve the App.
Please check all of the Above Things before submitting your App to Freetime App Store. It will cost less Time for you and me.

If the App passes all these checks, I will rebuild the App from the source code. I do this to ensure that the App is safe to use and does not contain any malicious code. I then use the latest Release provided by you from your Repository for Users to Download from the Freetime App Store.
